release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.3.31

• **Strengthened YouTube Music Search & Recommendations**: Always queries unfiltered YouTube Music alongside the Songs filter (plus raw-query fallback) so indie/YouTube-only uploads and official music videos are never hidden behind unrelated Songs-filter matches.
• **Fixed Official & Music Video Track Filtering**: Stopped dropping tracks with 'Official Video', 'Official Music Video', or 'Music Video' in their titles in both search and related-track recommendations, using only a mild tie-breaker so pure audio still wins ties.
• **Improved 'Title by Artist' Search Ranking**: Strips 'by' connectors when cleaning queries and boosts combined title + artist token matches so queries like '101 by raihan rahee' surface the exact track at the top.
• **Previous v3.3.1 Fixes Included**: Stacked AI Mixes mobile header layout, canonical album discovery/search/playback, editorial album & artist UI redesign, and 14 dynamic color palettes.
